Hi Stephanie / Lauren,

We’re preparing to sign the renewal and add an extra 200 GPU-hours/month for our analytics pipeline (estimated $21k/month). Finance asked me to confirm a few billing details before we send the PO:

2) Net terms: we can request Net60 but this requires finance sign-off; tagging Marissa to approve.

4) Tax docs: if the invoices will be issued to the EU entity, send the EU VAT/EORI and the legal entity name + registered address. For US routing we need a completed W9.

I’ve attached a blank amendment template and our W9 for reference (attachment: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf). I’ll prepare a short amendment (term change + capacity addendum) and share a DocuSign link to keep turnaround quick.
